ops.title: Check changed-since-answer atomically with PR-card redraw mutation
ops.description:
Owner: Yasyf Mohamedali, implementation owner of this branch.
Evidence: prlinks.go:731-738 checks changedSinceAnswer before calling replacePRCard; the posting redraw path does the same at :408-418. livecards.go:688-696 releases cards.mu after the check. replacePRCard later reacquires it at :1511 and overwrites m.Card at :1532 without checking the answer again. answerPRCard can claim and mark the answer meanwhile (cardaction.go:689-695).
Failing interleaving: recard checks an open old card against a new changed line, the engineer answers the old card, then replacePRCard stores the new content while retaining the same-waits answer. Future tap_prs posts compare against the newly stored changed line and no longer request a fresh card.
Next step: place the answered-version check inside the same locked mutation as replacePRCard, return its replacement-needed result to the posting path, and add a barrier-controlled redraw/tap regression.

ops.text: An answer recorded after redraw preparation but before card mutation leaves the answered content unchanged.
The next tap_prs post creates exactly one fresh card and marks the original replaced; CI runs the deterministic regression under the race detector.
